features.feature: Sign in… opens the browser and comes back signed in; Sign out forgets the token and the calendar falls back to today's agenda; another app id or tenant can be set
The calendar's week comes from Microsoft 365 without blocking the window
A recorded meeting's chat (and an ad-hoc call's) is kept with the call
Send a test and `deliver send` go only to the user's own Teams chat and mailbox (or a plugin's way), with no address to name; a routine also mails the addresses the user set on it
`echoctl m365` sends nothing without `--yes`: it answers what would be sent
Thread mail and chats are read only from the user, colleagues and trusted, authenticated senders; others wait in the Inbox

Mail sent from a thread's item (`m365 mail send|reply --task <thread>/<item>`, the follow-up-mail skill) is followed by it: replies in its conversation (no source rule; trusted senders only) come back as the thread's evidence saying which item they answer, and the sync clears or updates its wait
A run Echo started (Yolo) may leave a mail draft in Microsoft 365 Drafts, never send, reply or post; its outcome names where each draft is and links to a Microsoft 365 one
